Possessed Armor floating in!|audio = TakeoverExtremeWave13.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 13 ([[The Takeover Event]], Extreme)}} }} ==Description== The '''Possessed Armor''' is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] and Fallen Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a decent speed and has a decent amount of health. It also has 50% defense, reducing most forms of damage by 33.33%. As it loses its [[Shield Health]], it loses pieces of its armor. Once it loses all of its [[Shield Health]], it will no longer have any armor. This doubles its speed and makes it a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, meaning that you need to use towers with hidden detection to kill it. It can only be spawned by the [[Fallen King]]. The [[Awakened Fallen King]] also used to be able to spawn it. ==Logbook Description== "''These suits of armor once belonged to the kingdom's greatest Champions, displayed in halls of honor. When the curse swept through, the residual magic within animated them. The armor conceals something inside, and many believe it holds the souls of the lost Champions trapped within. Whether the armor truly contains the Champions' souls has yet to be discovered.''" ==Appearance== The '''Possessed Armor''' is a possessed set of armor. It is a light blue and grey armor, with multiple blue gems on it. It wears a grey helmet with two blue horns on it. As it loses shield health, it gradually loses armor until all of it is gone, revealing the entity that wears it. The entity has translucent black body with multiple blue cracks on its body. It also has neon blue eyes. It also does not have any legs. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Engineer]] can be useful against this. **The [[Ranger]] is unable to kill it as it lacks hidden detection. *The [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to give your towers hidden detection, allowing them to target the '''Possessed Armor''' even after it becomes [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. **The [[UAV]] can also be used, but it requires the consumable to be used and is only temporary. It does, however, provide a range boost and has map wide range. *The '''Possessed Armor''' is quite fast. Because of this, slowing towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]], [[Warden]] or [[Brawler]] can be very useful at slowing it down. **As it is only [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] after losing its armor, the [[Tesla]], [[Sledger]] and [[Cryomancer]] can be used to slow it down while it is not hidden. **Multiple of these towers can also be used to drop its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} PossessedArmorStunAnimation.gif|Current stun animation, with armor variant (2 August 2024 – Present) PossessedArmorWithoutCoverStun.gif|Current stun animation, without armor variant (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1PossessedArmorWithoutArmor.png|Green variant, current version, without armor variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpsePossessedArmor1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Gatling Gun Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Possessed Armor''' on a promotional video.
